CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 26, 2018 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPOINTMENT TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION – It is recommended the City Council appoint Amy Day to the Public Safety Commission for an unexpired term ending in June 2019.

8.1 Minutes of June 12, 2018 SS Mtg.
8.1 Minutes of June 12, 2018 CC Mtg.

APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 26, 2018 in the total amount of $3,016,435.29.

MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MAY 2018 â€“ It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending May 2018.

APPROVAL OF SITE ENGINEERING SERVICES FOR COUNTY GROUNDS MAINTENANCE AND SERVICE YARD AT LA MIRADA REGIONAL PARK - It is recommended the City Council approve the CNC Engineering proposal dated May 16, 2018 for site engineering service for the county grounds maintenance and service yard at La Mirada Regional Park including the optional tasks for a total of amount of $111,301; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total contract amount.

9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 18-11 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2018-19 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 18-11 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget.
9.1 Resolution No. 18-11 Adoption of FY 2018-19 Budget
9.2
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-01, LA MIRADA CREEK PARK MASTER PLAN - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 18-17 CERTIFYING THE INITIAL STUDY/MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND ACCEPTING THE LA MIRADA CREEK PARK MASTER PLAN - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 18-17 certifying the Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration and approving the La Mirada Creek Park Master Plan.
9.2 CIP No. 2017-01 - Resolution No. 18-17
9.3
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 705 AMENDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS ASSOCIATED WITH "ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS" (FORMERLY, "SECOND DWELLING UNITS") AND ADOPTING RELATED MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENTS TO TITLE 21 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE – It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the CEQA Exemption; and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 705 amending La Mirada Municipal Code sections associated with "Accessory Dwelling Units" (formerly, "Second Dwelling Units") and adopting related amendments to Title 21 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, consistent with state law, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.3 Ordinance No. 705 - First Reading
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 18-12 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19 - It is recommended the City Council select the California Per Capita Personal Income percentage change from the preceding year as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2018-19; select the growth of the County as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2018-19; and adopt Resolution No. 18-12 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2018-19 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
10.1 Resolution No. 18-12
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 18-13 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION NO. 17-21 AND RESOLUTION NO. 18-01 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-13 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment, and superseding Resolution No. 17-21 and Resolution No. 18-01.
10.2 Resolution No. 18-13
10.3
RESOLUTION NO. 18-14 REGARDING PAYING AND REPORTING THE VALUE OF EMPLOYER PAID MEMBER CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-14 regarding paying and reporting the value of employer paid member contributions to California Public Employees' Retirement System.
10.3 Resolution No. 18-14
10.4
RESOLUTION NO. 18-15 OPPOSING THE TAX FAIRNESS, TRANSPARENCY AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2018 – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-15 opposing the Tax Fairness, Transparency and Accountability Act of 2018.
10.4 Resolution No. 18-15
10.5
RESOLUTION NO. 18-16 APPROVING THE EXCHANGE OF CITY PROPERTY TAX TO COUNTY LIGHTING MAINTENANCE DISTRICT 1687 – PARCEL MAP 73221 – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-16 approving the exchange of City property tax to County Lighting Maintenance District.
10.5 Resolution No. 18-16
